companies.name: The Brooklyn Home Company
companies.quote: The three principals are involved in real estate development as founder, development director and creative director of The Brooklyn Home Company, a luxury real estate developer which constructs and renovates properties with custom design elements, environmental features and integrated art while following passive house principles.
